title: Closing Performance Gap for Diffusion Language Models under Low Inference Budgets
abstract: arXiv:2611.25763v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Diffusion language models offer an architectural route to low-budget generation by updating multiple tokens in parallel, which can reduce the number of sequential decoding steps relative to token-by-token autoregressive decoding. However, realizing this advantage at low budgets is challenging, as generation quality often declines when the number of denoising and refinement steps is reduced. Editable diffusion models address this quality loss through post-draft refinement, but useful intermediate results may still be lost before final submission. We introduce CaRR (Commitment-aware Refinement and Recovery), a training-free framework which improves submission quality from a fixed editable checkpoint through updated-context refill and trajectory-based recovery within its existing forward schedule. translated_title: 在低推理预算下缩小扩散语言模型的性能差距
translated_abstract: 扩散语言模型通过并行更新多个 token，为低预算生成提供了一条架构层面的途径，与逐 token 的自回归解码相比，可以减少顺序解码步骤的数量。然而，在低预算下实现这一优势颇具挑战，因为当去噪和细化步骤的数量减少时，生成质量往往会下降。可编辑扩散模型通过草稿后细化来应对这种质量损失，但在最终提交之前，有用的中间结果可能仍然会丢失。我们提出了 CaRR（Commitment-aware Refinement and Recovery，承诺感知的细化与恢复），这是一个无需训练的框架，它在现有的前向调度内，通过更新上下文回填和基于轨迹的恢复，从固定的可编辑检查点提升提交质量。其中 Token Commitment Remasking（TCR，token 承诺重掩码）会对选定的原生纯替换进行重掩码，并在下一个预定的编辑前向中使用更新后的内容进行回填。
tldr: 提出了无需训练的 CaRR 框架，通过 token 承诺重掩码、更新上下文回填和基于轨迹的恢复机制，在低推理预算下提升可编辑扩散语言模型的生成质量，从而缩小其性能差距。
en_tdlr: CaRR is a training-free framework that improves submission quality of editable diffusion language models under low inference budgets via Token Commitment Remasking, updated-context refill, and trajectory-based recovery.
